name: explore_plan_build
title: Explore -> Plan -> Approve -> Build -> Integrate
description: Explore the codebase, produce a structured task_list.v1 plan, pause at a human/coordinator gate, then fan out across planned items and finish with an integration review of the combined result.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: High-level objective for the feature or change

brief.goal: Explore the codebase and identify key files, constraints, and risks for: {{inputs.goal}}
acceptance: Summary of relevant modules, entry points, and risks submitted as JSON output

brief.goal: Based on exploration ({{stage.explore.output.summary}}), decompose '{{inputs.goal}}' into concrete work items, each with a goal and checkable acceptance criteria.
acceptance: Structured task_list.v1 output with a non-empty goal and acceptance criteria per item

gate.prompt: Approve the generated plan ({{stage.plan.output.summary}}) before building?

acceptance: Implementation for {{item.key}} is complete and meets its acceptance criteria; the checks run and their outcomes are reported in the submit summary

brief.goal: Integrate all built items for {{inputs.goal}} and check that they work together
acceptance: All changes integrate cleanly; the integration checks chosen and their outcomes are reported in the submit summary
